# origincloud_pvs_storage_class (Data Source)

A storage tier a volume is created in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "origincloud_pvs_storage_class" "general" {
  name = "storageClasses/gp1"
}

output "baseline_iops" {
  value = data.origincloud_pvs_storage_class.general.baseline_iops
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The class's resource name, `storageClasses/gp1`.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the class can be selected right now. A class that is listed but not available is a published tier not yet on sale.
- `baseline_iops` (Number) The I/O operations per second a volume of the class is limited to; 0 for a class not on sale.
- `baseline_throughput_mibps` (Number) The MiB per second a volume of the class is limited to; 0 for a class not on sale.
- `default_class` (Boolean) Whether a volume created without a storage class is created in this one.
- `display_name` (String) The name the console shows.
- `media` (String) The media the class is backed by. One of `SSD`, `HDD`.
